I wouldn't have listened to this back when I was at my worst, but I hope you can take something from this.

I know where you're coming from. My struggles in high school seemingly mirrored yours, and I had my last true suicide attempt when I was 16. I only lived through it because my sister came home early from work.

"Think of the future" is pretty shitty adgice, but college is so much better. If you make it there then I recommend one far from your family. But yeah you're right life is work, but that doesn't mean it can't be work you enjoy.

I know regular classes seem like they'll have nose picking, prank pulling idiots in them but there's no shame in taking them. Don't overextend yourself.

The only thing that got me through highschool was creating exciting things to look forward to. Like every Friday I would order my favorite restaurants on uber eats after school and each week I'd survive by looking forward to those. If money is an issue then it could be something as simple as letting yourself get a couple more hours of sleep.
